question.text: In order to prepare a buffer solution of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>pH</mi><mn>5</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>74</mn></math>, sodium acetate is added to acetic acid. If the concentration of acetic acid in the buffer is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mo>,</mo></math> the concentration of sodium acetate in the buffer is ______<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mo>.</mo></math> (Round off to the Nearest Integer). <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mi>Given</mi><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mi>pKa</mi><mfenced><mtext>acetic acid</mtext></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>74</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>
